snippet.title: As I Began to Dream  Trailer - New Improved Visual
snippet.description: Get ready to be mesmerized by the enhanced beauty of 'As I Began to Dream.' In this new trailer, we unveil the game's stunning visual upgrade that will transport you to a dream world like no other. Immerse yourself in the captivating story, ingenious puzzles, and a world where dreams come to life. Watch now and experience the magic of 'As I Began to Dream' in a whole new light. Your journey into a dreamworld of wonder begins here!
